clientScore is never reset to null (no setClientScore(null)); safe today only because the component unmounts on close (gameFlowOpen false in PrizeLeagueWorld). If a future flow keeps the component mounted across a client game -> server game transition, a stale client score would show. Consider resetting on attempt start.

Server games (number_sequence) show correctCount/target which ignores out-of-order taps (20/20 even with misses) - consistent with 'original' behaviour but inconsistent with client games now showing correct/(correct+wrong)
